Subject: MAP benchmark run results (first pass)

Sandra / Kimberly — attaching the first pass of the runs we discussed. High level summary below, full numbers are in the CSV.

Summary (2k token, warm cache):
- Target concurrency 50 (sustained): throughput 620 tokens/sec, median latency (TTFT) 1.8s, p95 320ms per token-equivalent window; overall request p95 ~1200ms (model-only).
- Spike test 100 concurrency (30s sustained): tail increased; p95 ~1.9s, observed backpressure at 120 concurrent sessions on the chosen instance class.
- Concurrency behavior: linear throughput up to ~60 concurrent steady requests; after that queueing increases TTFT nonlinearly.

Methodology: runs executed on g5.12xlarge equivalent; each condition repeated 10 times with 30s warm-up. CSV contains per-request timestamps, token counts, and environment tags.

Attachments: acme_latency_throughput_20260122.csv (CSV), acme_map_benchmark_results_slides_v1.pdf (PDF)

Notes for MAP: we recommend a staged rollout at 50 qps with a canary at 75 qps and a fallback policy to the smaller model variant if sustained TTFT > 2s for >5 minutes.
